n36f75407f5.headline: Council of Ministers: The Egyptian economy continues to excel thanks to the success of the reform program (infographic)
n36f75407f5.summary: Egypt's Council of Ministers stated the economy continues to excel due to successful reform programs, with international forecasts indicating strong growth in 2020.
n36f75407f5.why: Egypt's economic reforms aim to stabilize and grow the economy, attracting investment and supporting regional economic stability.
